_comment: What she says when a name or a message cannot be read. Three of each, rotated in order rather than picked at random, so two unreadable donations in a row do not get the same line. Edit freely — this file is read at startup and nothing in the code depends on the wording.
name_placeholders: One who shall not be named
Someone whose name I will not repeat
A viewer who picked their name badly
message_placeholders: their message was corrupted, so it stays unsaid
their message is not something I am going to read
the rest of that did not survive the trip here
